description_expanded:
Toast to the Coast | Inlet Beach 30A

323 Pompano Street, Inlet Beach, FL 32461

Directly on the Gulf, Toast to the Coast | 323 Pompano Street is an extraordinary beachfront estate offering four levels of panoramic Gulf views and an unmatched 30A experience. Complete with a private pool, private beach access, a chef's kitchen, and multiple primary suites, this remarkable vacation rental home was designed for unforgettable gatherings along Florida's Emerald Coast.

From the moment you arrive, the Gulf takes center stage. Expansive windows and multiple balconies showcase breathtaking views of the emerald waters and sugar-white sands, creating a stunning backdrop for your vacation. The first floor offers a comfortable living room, kitchenette for easy access from the pool or beach, and a full bathroom complete with a tiled walk-in shower.

At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen is found on the second floor, which is equipped for everything from casual breakfasts before the beach to memorable dinners shared with family and friends. The open living space flows seamlessly throughout the second floor, creating an inviting area to gather after a day spent on the water. Next you will find the master bedroom complete with a king size bed, sitting space, and private bathroom with a walk-in shower, soaking tub and dual vanity sinks. Additionally, the second floor hosts a bunk room that can sleep four guests, a half bathroom, and laundry room.

As you make your way to the top floor of the home, you are treated to breathtaking views of the Gulf. The top floor is dedicated to a private primary suite, where panoramic Gulf views create a truly unforgettable retreat. Whether you're enjoying morning coffee as the sun rises over the beach or unwinding with evening cocktails while listening to the waves, every level of the home offers a front-row seat to the beauty of the coast.

Outside, guests can choose between spending the day by the private pool or stepping directly onto the beach via private beach access. With the Gulf just steps away, it's easy to move between poolside lounging, long walks along the shoreline, and afternoons spent soaking up the Florida sunshine.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- **Elevator usage is not available for guests unless it is needed by an elderly or handicapped individual. Please contact Dune Vacation Rentals prior to the arrival date for such arrangements.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
